reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 12 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 85 times in 100, by about 13; most games like this end between 197 and 246 total points.
